mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase above 0.5% signals early monetary tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate declines signal an overheating economy triggering aggressive Fed tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1000 thousand units signal late-cycle expansion where economic growth peaks and equity valuations become stretched, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate trend over 3 months indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals excessive labor market tightness that triggers inflation concerns and Fed policy acceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production declines and housing starts increases signal supply-demand mismatch where manufacturing weakness cannot meet housing demand, causing inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO falling and HOUST rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105 (index 2017=100) signals supply-side constraints that reduce manufacturing output and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
